Big Homes, Big Loans
America’s wealthy house hunters are brushing off higher mortgage rates. In fact, demand for multimillion-dollar loans is booming. Originations over $5 million spiked more than 50% last year compared with 2024, according to Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data provided by the Mortgage Bankers Association.
